^orange;Pristal shards^reset; are a crystal-metal hybrid that can be forged into ^orange;prisilite^reset;, which you can then make into some very shiny equipment. It's also one of the three components of tritanium alloy, so be sure to pick some up for that, if nothing else.
^orange;Telebrium^reset; is a crystal almost always found on moons, alongside erchius. It can conduct energy, but it's also strong against concussive force, so it's pretty versatile.

^orange;Lead^reset; poisoning is about the most mundane danger you'll be facing while you explore space - assuming you're a carbon lifeform, anyway - but do still be aware of it. Despite that, lead's super useful, especially for alloys, so do pick some up.
This is ^orange;irradium^reset;, and it makes your Geiger counter sing like an Avian! Its radioactivity can be made dormant, and it can then be made into some dangerous equipment, or strong alloys.

Among the many weird minerals of the universe, ^orange;sivite^reset; is surprisingly NOT one of the kinds you can make into wacky armor and weapons you won't ever get around to using. Rather, it's a nice source of magnesium powder and phosphorus if you extract it.
^orange;Protocite^reset; is only found on Proto Worlds. You can liquify it to power stuff, make it into alloys, or most importantly, make quantum computer chips from it.
That's pure ^orange;carbon^reset;. You can make it into carbon plating, or graphene, which are both great to have. Make sure to stock up on it if you can.

^orange;Cinnabar^reset; is a great source of mercury, if you extract it. This stuff, especially. It's actually very rare for it to be this pure! On Earth, anyway. The geology of the crazy planets we've been visiting might be a different case.
What you've just picked up is called ^orange;lasombrium^reset;, and it is a really creepy metal that phases in and out of reality, apparently. That is all the data I have on it.
That's ^orange;densinium^reset;! It is the toughest metal known to all of science, and it even glows purple, like the mythical, legendary ore it is. So cool...
^orange;Graphene^reset; is lovely stuff to have. It's used mostly as a capacitor to make advanced circuits, but it's also a great material to make equipment with.
^orange;Sulphur^reset; is useful for making fertilizers. It can also be extracted to get sulphuric acid, which is necessary for making batteries.
^orange;Magnesite^reset; is a great source of magnesium, if you smelt it or extract it. Magnesium is good to have for a fair few things, mostly involving biology.
^orange;Mascagnite^reset; is a good source of ammonium sulfate, if you extract it. 'Course, there's about a dozen other different ways to get it too...

That's ^orange;penumbrite^reset;, which is only found in penumbral biomes. Refine this stuff into shards, and you can craft some sleek equipment that looks the cool kind of alien. It's also useful for alloys, too.
^orange;Quietus^reset; is... well, it's, um, alive, kind of? I don't know, man. I guess you can still make it into stuff, but... Eugh...
^orange;Lunari^reset; is a particularly shiny breed of crystal. This stuff is everywhere on crystalline planets. If you refine it, you can make it into stuff just like you would a metal.
^orange;Zerchesium^reset; has an impressive melting point, so turn up the heat on your furnace if you plan to smelt it. You can use it to make advanced alloys, or a number of other neat things.
